ui.title: Mario Tennis Fever Recomp — Setup
ui.intro: Builds a playable Mario Tennis Fever PC folder from your own legal copy of the game (v1.1.1): lifts the game code to C, translates the shaders to SPIR-V and compiles the native executable on this PC.
ui.notice: The folder this setup builds contains your own game files. It is for personal use only — never share or upload it.
ui.pick_game_folder: Choose the folder with the game's files
ui.game_help: Version 1.1.1 of the game: a .nup with the base game and the update, or a folder with exefs and romfs of the update. The game itself needs no keys file.
ui.dlss: Download NVIDIA DLSS (nvngx_dlss.dll) for NVIDIA RTX graphics cards
ui.dlss_help: Checks if nvngx_dlss.dll is already in the install folder (and skips on non-RTX GPUs) before downloading from NVIDIA's DLSS SDK on GitHub (NVIDIA RTX SDK license). Without it, DLAA and DLSS settings do nothing.
ui.update_mode: This folder holds an earlier installation. The setup continues or updates it; the game is asked for only if it is needed again.
ui.need_game: Choose the game: the .nup or a folder.
